name: ai-limits-monitor-for-linux
description: AI Limits Monitor for Linux: desktop usage monitor for Claude Code and Codex subscription limits.

scripts.check:gnome: node --check gnome/cache-events.js && node --check gnome/snapshot.js && node --check gnome/extension.js && node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"; JSON.parse(await readFile("gnome/metadata.json", "utf8"));'
